name: GPU K-D Tree Ray Traversal
definition: A hierarchical spatial partitioning structure where each node is divided into two sub-nodes by a plane orthogonal to an axis, positioned arbitrarily along that axis within the node. It is a special case of BSP-Tree.
summary: GPU K-D Tree Ray Traversal accelerates ray tracing on graphics hardware by efficiently skipping empty space, distinguished by its adaptation to GPU architectures like single-pass dynamic branching.
